title: Jazzy Syrian Dates Wrap
description: A sweet, snappy Syrian-inspired wrap that showcases fresh dates, feta, and aromatic spices, perfect for a Mediterranean snack.
instructions: Warm the flatbreads in a dry skillet over medium heat until soft and pliable, about 1 minute per side.
In a small bowl stir together the tahini, lemon juice, ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, za'atar, a pinch of salt, and pepper until smooth.
Slice each date lengthwise, leaving the blossom end intact for a decorative touch, and spread a small amount of the tahini mixture on each flatbread.
Sprinkle crumbled feta, chopped walnuts, toasted pine nuts, and chopped mint over the tahini layer evenly.
Fold the flatbread over the fillings and roll tightly, securing the edge with a teaspoon of olive oil if needed.
Serve the wraps warm, optionally drizzled with a little extra tahini or lemon zest for presentation.
